title: index.jsonl record
description: One line of index.jsonl, the machine-floor projection (ADR-0046, T-204). A projection artifact like llms.txt: computed from document frontmatter, deterministic, not format-binding, not load-bearing for conformance. Every value is a faithful copy of the pointed-to document's frontmatter; the linter (L22) verifies the whole file is a faithful render where it exists.

path.description: Root-relative POSIX path — for a source, its current canonical file; otherwise the document file.

type.description: Derived-doc type (summary, entity, concept, question, insight); absent for other kinds.

origin.description: Source origin facts (system, ref, upstream_ref) — present on sources only.

tier.description: The source's capture tier; present on sources only.

provenance.description: Derived docs: the grounding sources, id + recorded content hash.

evidence.description: Decisions: evidence-linked source ids (links, not provenance).
